definitions.explanation: An initial, unrefined version of a plan, proposal, or document that serves as the basis for further discussion and revision. Often the first stage in a formal planning process.

examples.japanese: {素案|そあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧。
⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{新|あら}しい⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素案|そあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The committee announced a preliminary plan for the new system.

examples.japanese: ⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧{素案|そあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ことにした。
examples.english: We decided to put together a rough draft first, then listen to the opinions of those involved.

notes:
Composed of {素|そ} (plain, raw, unfinished) and ⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧ (plan, proposal). Frequently used in government, business, and academic contexts where plans go through multiple rounds of review before finalization.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {素案|そあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧: to prepare a draft
- {素案|そあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提示|ていじ}する→提示する：26842_teijisuru⟧: to present a draft
- {素案|そあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧: to compile a preliminary plan
- {素案|そあん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧: at the draft stage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{草案|そうあん}→草案：15762_souan⟧: draft (of a document or law) — slightly more developed than a {素案|そあん}
- ⟦{原案|げんあん}→原案：11978_genan⟧: original plan; original draft — the version that formally enters review
- ⟦{下書|したが}き→下書き：06836_shitagaki⟧: draft; rough copy — more general, often used for personal writing
- ⟦たたき{台|だい}→たたき台：08314_tatakidai⟧: starting point for discussion — informal, implies something meant to be revised

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in news reports, government documents, and business meetings.
